title: Room names in format like 01-13 or 14-05 are converted to month/date in Export Room Data file
transfer_ready_reason: No explicit approval evidence; open questions Q1-Q3 need PM/Eng decision before planning.

stories.text: Admin sees room names exactly as in Device Hub when opening export in Excel
Desk export shows desk names exactly (conditional on Q3)

acceptance_criteria.text: 01-13, 06-03, 12-5, 14-05 display as text in Excel (en-US + one non-US locale); 0 of 4 shown as dates
Holds for all 4 export variants and for page 2+ rows without header
Non-date-like names byte-identical to pre-fix output
Commas, quotes, leading zeros preserved; unit test asserts exact CSV text
Technique documented in PR and covered by Generate unit test
No change to other columns, Index order or header text

constraints.text: Remain CSV unless Q1 selects XLSX
No change to stored data or Device Hub UI
Keep valid for non-Excel consumers (trade-off in Q1)
SanitizeForInjection currently off; formula-style text-force conflicts if re-enabled

contradictions.text: Title lists 14-05, which is not a valid month-day in en-US; conversion is locale dependent

open_questions.text: Fix technique: conditional text-force (recommended) vs always text-force vs XLSX
Any customer integration or planned feature that re-imports or parses the room export CSV (none found in code)
Scope: Desk export, other text columns, Connect-WebApiService exporter (possibly legacy)
Exact date-like pattern list that triggers text-forcing
Locale and Excel version test matrix; does 14-05 reproduce
Ticket screenshots and comments were not readable; confirm no extra guidance

assumptions: Users open the CSV by double-click in Excel
Name reaches Generate unmodified from the room source

recommendation.technique: Conditional text-force (Excel formula-text) on Name for date-like values, implemented once in ExportRoomService.Generate or RoomExportModel so all four variants and all pages are covered
recommendation.import_roundtrip: No room CSV import found in Connect-ScreenManager, Connect-SelfService or Connect-WebApiService (only user-email BulkUserUploadHelper); risk limited to external consumers (Q2)

acceptance_criteria_lint.notes: Q4 pattern list and Q5 locale matrix still needed to fully fix AC1 inputs

evidence_gaps: Compliance enrichment not run (atlassian, endor-cli-tools, basic-memory MCP failed to connect)
WebApiService exporter caller not confirmed (bounded search)
Desk export path in ScreenManager not traced
